data.body: Landed as e1352535ac on gerrit/main (change 1656, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, plain Submit). Gerrit rebased server-side onto d2e96326a2. Verified against the merged commit in a realigned worktree: the per-kind claim is present and tests/unit/test_completion_tool_policy.py passes 14/14. All six acceptance criteria met - AC1-AC3 by the 8-trial live experiment recorded above (4/4 false unmet on origin/main, 0/4 after, with governed calls, run steps and tokens all DOWN), AC4 by the deterministic unit contract, AC5 by the unchanged notice constants and surfaces, AC6 by lint, mypy over 508 files, 355 focused tests, and Verified +1. Note the GitHub mirror lagged the Gerrit tip by one commit at close time; origin/main will carry e1352535ac once the mirror syncs.
